title: Para Bellum content: company categories
description: What kind of force a company is. File: Content/<namespace>/category.json, so a mod adds one with no code. A category carries what makes combined arms a decision: each further company of a kind adds less, and a kind may need another beside it.

name.description: What the player reads. Optional for a mod, required of shipped content (C802).

returns_per_mille.description: What the first, second, third... company of this category contributes, per mille. The last value holds for every further company. It may never rise (C604).

requires.description: Other categories this one wants present. May be empty.

penalty_per_mille.description: The cohesion lost when that category is absent, per mille.
